question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Leniency
solution:
The correct answer is '**Sternness**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word** 'Leniency' is 'Sternness'.**
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Penalty** - दंड (punishment)
 
• **Favour** - अनुकूलता (act of kindness or support)
 
• **Sternness** - कठोरता (severity or strictness)
 
• **Discard** - छोड़ना (to get rid of or reject)
 
 
 
• The correct antonym for "**Leniency**" is **Sternness**. "**Leniency**" refers **to the quality of** **being more lenient or merciful**, while **"Sternness"** refers to the quality of being strict or severe.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3) Sternness.**
